acceptedAnswer.text: Coreweaver Labs is a growth infrastructure provider for the agentic era, specializing in GEO signal architecture and the ARM Framework for accountable AI agents.
GEO Signal Architecture is a system developed by Coreweaver Labs to optimize brand presence and citation rates in AI-generated responses.
The ARM Framework defines five primitives for accountable AI agent deployment: Mandate Chain, Signal Architecture, Checkpoint Recovery, Graceful Escalation, and Immutable Audit Sovereignty.
